description: Technician began opening the pump discharge flange before isolation was verified. Residual pressure remained in the line.
Welder continued cutting after the atmospheric gas test validity period had expired.
Worker entered the crane swing radius while a suspended load was being moved.
Technician worked from an elevated platform with the harness lanyard disconnected.
Worker entered the vessel before the confined-space permit and atmospheric test were confirmed.
Operator bypassed the machine interlock to restart the equipment.
The fire extinguisher inspection label is due for routine monthly renewal next week.
